_comment: Canonical methodology metadata returned by /methodology endpoint per doc 07 §26. Versioned by SemVer; methodology_url always points to diboas-analytics.com. v1.1.0 (2026-09-16, founder-ratified): ETF-01's data route, universe, aggregation basis and window changed on 2026-07-11 (commit 6aadb3ca) — Polygon shares-outstanding snapshots x Yahoo price as NAV proxy, Friday-to-Friday, across 11 tickers, computed as the sum over tickers of (shares_t - shares_t-1) x price_t. Per register 5.132(a), which read doc 02 when the drift was found, the prior text described a manual Google Sheets/CSV route summing net_flow_usd Mon-Fri across 10 ETFs; doc 02 is not readable from this repository and that description is NOT re-verified here. A 7+/-1 day week-span rule was added 2026-09-14 (register 5.301): a gap outside that window is no longer published as a weekly aggregate. MINOR, not MAJOR: the 14-point scale, the eleven signals, the five bands and the four group ceilings are unchanged, so scores remain comparable. Every run day in run-archive.jsonl predating this bump is PRE-VERSIONING and is not retro-stamped (register 5.376). The matching doc 02 §9/§8.3 correction is routed to the diboas-analytics lane. Prior: v1.0.1 (2026-05-29) aligned score_bands to canonical doc 02 §6.1 (HOSTILE 0-2, DEFENSIVE 3-5).
